summary.name: MinimalClock
summary.one_liner: MinimalClock is a minimalist clock screensaver for macOS, meant to be used as a room clock and focus aid.
use_cases: display a clock in your room on a Mac
focus while working on a Mac
clock suitable for day and night viewing
summary.what_it_does: The page presents MinimalClock as a screensaver for macOS that works as a clock for a room. It is described as simple, elegant and suitable for both day and night use. The page says it is intended to help the user focus while working. A download button is provided, but the page does not describe specific settings, clock styles or other features.
notable: Suitable for both day and night use
caveats: Available for macOS only, per the page
Pricing and license not stated on the page
